verdict.rationale: Bento has reusable email templates (bento-docs-37), and its CLI lists "manage templates" among its commands (bento-docs-49), so templates can be handled programmatically to some degree. However, the docs describe templates as plain text or drag-and-drop built (bento-docs-63) rather than code-first, and the only Liquid-variable evidence covers webhook payloads, not templates. missing for 10: HTML/MJML template authoring, documented template API endpoints, variable substitution in templates, version-control/templates-as-code workflow, independent corroboration.
